description: Find the final exam score you need to reach your target grade.

faqs.a: Enter your current grade %, the final exam's weight %, and your target overall %. The tool computes the required exam score.
Formula: required = (target − current × (1 − w)) ÷ w, where w is the exam weight as a decimal.
It tells you plainly — e.g. if you need 112%, it shows that the target is impossible with this exam weight.
faqs.q: What if the required score is over 100%?

faqs.a: It shows a negative or zero required score, meaning you can score 0 and still hit your target.
faqs.q: What if I already have the grade locked in?

howto: Enter the final exam's weight percentage.
Enter the overall grade you are targeting.
Click Calculate — see the exam score you need.
title: Final Exam Calculator
